Class VFXManager

java.lang.Object
vfx.VFXManager
public class VFXManager extends Object
Static manager for all visual effects (VFX) rendered on top of the game world.

VFX are grouped into five independent lists, each updated and rendered in a specific layer of the draw stack:

  1. Ground effects (WorldEffect) — drawn beneath enemies/player; follow or are fixed in world space.
  2. Damage texts (DamageText) — floating numbers that drift upward and fade out after a hit.
  3. Slashes (Slash) — brief directional slash animations.
  4. Screen effects (WorldEffect) — full-screen overlays such as flash effects; rendered last so they cover everything.
  5. Skill pop-ups (SkillPopUp) — skill activation icons briefly shown at the top of the screen.

Effects are added via the spawn* / set*Effects factory methods and removed automatically when DamageText.isExpired() (or the equivalent for other types) returns true.

All methods are static — this class is never instantiated.

    • spawnDamageText

      public static void spawnDamageText(double x, double y, double amount, javafx.scene.paint.Color color)
      Spawns a floating damage number at the given world position.

      A small random jitter is applied to X and Y so that numbers spawned on the same enemy in the same frame do not perfectly overlap.

      Parameters:
      x - world X of the hit entity
      y - world Y of the hit entity
      amount - damage value to display
      color - text colour (e.g. Color.WHITE for physical, Color.YELLOW for burn)
